main.description: Assert a first-class SUPPLY edge (supplier → customer) into the kotoba Datom log (:supply.edge/*). Records a DISCLOSED public supplier relationship only (company filing / IR disclosure / press), with the commodity that flows and a bounded dependency-strength estimate. AGGREGATE-FIRST + sourcing-honest (kabuto G2/G3/G5): criticality is :representative or :synthesized, NEVER a contract figure, and is framed toward supply-chain redundancy + accountability, never interdiction.

tier.description: supplier tier relative to customer (1 = direct), if disclosed

criticalityBp.description: disclosed dependency strength in BASIS POINTS of 1.0 (0..1000 = 0.0..1.0, integer implied units); high = customer concentrated on this supplier (NOT a contract value)

sourcing.description: kabuto G5; disclosed supplier edges are typically :representative
